content.what_it_is: MATLAB bathymetry generator for the FUNWAVE-TVD rip_2d case; header comment states it generates bathymetry for the TVD-Boussinesq model to study symmetry breaking in periodic bathymetry (L1-L6). Domain: ncell=5 periodic cells (L10) of alongshore spacing ycell=100 (L14), cross-shore scale xcell=100 (L18); dx=1, dy=2, plane-beach slope s=1/30, channel center xc=100, hole amplitude a=1.5, Gaussian variance sig2=xc*xc/4, anisotropy bet=2 (L22); x from -11 to 5*xcell, y cell-centered from dy/2 to ncell*ycell-dy/2 (L23), meshgrid (L24). Base depth h=s*xx (planar beach; L27). Rip channel cell centers yc=(0:ncell)*ycell (L31); a symmetry-breaking shift of one center is commented out (L33-L35). For each of ncell+1 centers, subtracts an anisotropic Gaussian a*exp(-((xx-xc).^2+bet*(yy-yc).^2)/sig2) (L37-L41), producing periodic shore-parallel bars cut by rip channels. Depth clipped at 13 m (L43). Draws a quick contour with levels v=0..10 (L45-L47), saves the field as ASCII depth_a15.txt (L49), then makes a 6x6 inch figure (L51-L54) with pcolor of -h and white contours at v1=-10..0 (L55-L62), axis labels (L63-L64).
entities: ncell number of periodic cells L10
xx, yy meshgrid L24 (reassigned as 1D vectors L56-L57)

equations.ref: anisotropic Gaussian depression per cell center

verbatim_spans.text: % generate bathymetry for TVD-boussinesq model to study effect of symmetry

unresolved: x starts at -11 (L23) giving 11 m of dry land (h<0) behind the shoreline; the choice of -11 rather than a round number is unexplained
the symmetry-breaking line (L35) is commented out, so this saved depth_a15.txt is the symmetric configuration; filename suffix a15 matches a=1.5 (L22)

the Gaussians at yc=0 and yc=ncell*ycell=500 are truncated at the domain edges (y spans dy/2..499); periodic wrap consistency is left to the model's periodic boundary condition and is not enforced here
xx,yy change meaning mid-script from meshgrid arrays (L24) to 1D plot vectors (L56-L57)
